'''Defender''' can refer to the following:

==Titles==
*[[Defender of Amadicia]] - a title of the monarch of [[Amadicia]].
*[[Defender of Garen's Wall]] - a title of the monarch of [[Ghealdan]].
*[[Defender of the Heartland]] - a [[Saldaea]]n title, currently held by [[Davram Bashere]]. 
*[[Defender of the Realm]] - a title of the monarch of [[Andor]].
*[[Defender of the Wall of First Fires]] - a title of [[Lan Mandragoran]].
*[[Defender of the Waves]] - a title of [[First of Mayene|First]] of [[Mayene]].

==Others==
*[[Defenders of the Stone]] - guards of the [[Heart of the Stone]] in [[Tear]].
*[[The Defender of the Dragonwall]] - an inn in [[Cairhien]].
